items.title: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
items.why_relevant: Provides working-capital loans starting at ₹10,000 (with subsequent tranches of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000) and a 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment for urban street vendors, which may help replace high-cost informal supplier credit.
items.eligibility_summary: Available to street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas with a Certificate of Vending / Identity Card or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from the Urban Local Body (ULB) or Town Vending Committee (TVC). Final eligibility depends on municipal records and lender verification.
requirements_to_verify: Aadhaar card linked with an active mobile number
Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by ULB, or Letter of Recommendation
items.disclaimer: Eligibility and approval must be verified with the official provider and participating lending institution.

items.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
items.why_relevant: PMMY loans are offered through banks, NBFCs and MFIs to eligible non-corporate, non-farm micro enterprises. The Shishu category covers loans up to ₹50,000; Kishor covers amounts above ₹50,000 up to ₹5,00,000.
items.eligibility_summary: Micro-enterprise needs may be considered for income-generating manufacturing, trading, service and allied activities. A lender assesses the application and decides terms; MUDRA itself does not lend directly to the individual.
requirements_to_verify: Identity and address proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Business details or activity proof requested by the chosen lender
Quotation for equipment or working-capital estimate
Last 6 months bank statement if available
items.disclaimer: Eligibility and approval must be verified with the official provider and lending bank/NBFC-MFI.

items.title: e-Shram — National Database of Unorganised Workers
items.why_relevant: Provides a universal UAN card for unorganised workers (including street vendors and small traders) and links to social-security and accidental insurance benefits.
items.eligibility_summary: The Ministry of Labour & Employment describes e-Shram as registration for unorganised workers aged 16 and above. Check the live portal for current eligibility and registration rules.
requirements_to_verify: Any further bank details requested by the live registration flow
items.disclaimer: Eligibility and approval must be verified with the official provider (Ministry of Labour & Employment).

items.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
items.why_relevant: Offers access to a basic savings bank account and financial services. RuPay card cover and any overdraft depend on the current scheme terms, account conditions and participating bank verification.
items.eligibility_summary: Visit the official portal or a participating bank to check current account-opening and overdraft terms. A bank verifies KYC and account status.
requirements_to_verify: Aadhaar card or officially valid KYC document
items.disclaimer: Eligibility and approval must be verified with the official provider and participating bank branch.

items.title: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) & PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
items.why_relevant: Low-premium accident insurance (₹20/year for ₹2,00,000 accidental death/disability cover under PMSBY) and life insurance (₹436/year for ₹2,00,000 cover under PMJJBY) to protect household reserves against sudden shocks.
items.eligibility_summary: Savings bank or post-office account holders aged 18–70 years (PMSBY) or 18–50 years (PMJJBY) who give auto-debit consent before the annual renewal cycle.
requirements_to_verify: Active savings bank or post-office account
Signed auto-debit consent form with nominee details
items.disclaimer: Eligibility and approval must be verified with the official provider and your bank or post office.
